fields.presetHint: Applies a starter layout tuned by flash size and chip family.
fields.firmwareSizeHint: KiB, rounded to 64 KiB for app partition sizing safety margin.
fields.appSlotSizeHint: KiB per app slot. Must exceed firmware target + headroom.
fields.nvsSizeHint: KiB. ESP-IDF recommends at least 0x3000 (12 KiB).

output.title: Generated partitions.csv
output.layoutValid: Layout is valid for the selected flash size and alignment constraints.

encryption.title: Encryption Settings
encryption.subtitle: Select encryption per active partition. Hover the info badge for recommendations.

tooltipStatus.auto: Automatically encrypted when Flash Encryption is enabled

tooltip.app: ESP-IDF always encrypts app partitions when Flash Encryption is enabled.
tooltip.otadata: ESP-IDF always encrypts otadata when Flash Encryption is enabled.
tooltip.nvsKeys: NVS key partitions are always encrypted when Flash Encryption is enabled.
tooltip.nvs: Recommended when NVS stores credentials, keys, tokens, or sensitive settings.
tooltip.coredump: Recommended in production; coredumps can contain sensitive memory content.
tooltip.efuse: eFuse emulation is mostly for development and is not recommended for production devices.
tooltip.storage: Encrypt if this filesystem stores credentials, secrets, or user-sensitive data.
tooltip.phy: Usually not required unless PHY data contains sensitive manufacturing calibration details.
tooltip.optional: Optional encryption. Enable based on your threat model and data sensitivity.

errors.exceedsFlash: Layout exceeds flash size by {size}. Reduce app or data partitions.

warnings.nvsTooSmall: NVS size is below ESP-IDF recommendation (0x3000 / 12 KiB). Consider increasing.
warnings.appHeadroom: App partition size is close to firmware target. Keep at least 256 KiB headroom for growth.
warnings.appAlign: App slot size is not aligned to 64 KiB. It was rounded up for generated CSV.
warnings.efuseProd: eFuse emulation partition is enabled. This is generally not recommended for production devices.
warnings.lowFreeSpace: Very little unallocated flash remains (< 128 KiB). Consider shrinking one partition less aggressively.
warnings.spiffsSmall: Small SPIFFS partitions can be inefficient. SPIFFS reliably uses about 75% of assigned space.
